name: colosseum-linter
description: IntelliSense and linting for Colosseum test scripts. Discovers colosseum.plugins in your active Python venv, generates Pylance stubs so col.equipment.* (and third-party namespaces) complete and Ctrl+Click correctly, and warns on unknown namespaces or plugin attributes.

colosseumLinter.stubPath.description: Workspace-relative directory for generated stubs (Pylance default stubPath is typings).

colosseumLinter.autoRefreshOnActivate.description: Regenerate stubs when the extension activates.

colosseumLinter.enableDiagnostics.description: Warn on unknown col.<namespace> / plugin attributes using the discovered catalog.

colosseumLinter.diagnosticSeverity.description: Severity for unknown Colosseum namespace/attribute diagnostics.
